title: Alien dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='g' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b6ff7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fc63a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2a4a7a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M44 72 L36 88 L42 90 L50 74 Z' fill='#7bf06b'/>
  <path d='M56 72 L66 86 L60 91 L50 74 Z' fill='#3bbf2e'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='89' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#2f9e28'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7bf06b'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='18' ry='20' fill='url(#g)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#e8ffb0' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- left arm up -->
  <path d='M34 50 L20 34 L25 29 L40 46 Z' fill='#7bf06b'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='31' r='5' fill='#b6ff7a'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M66 52 L82 44 L84 50 L68 58 Z' fill='#3bbf2e'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='47' r='5' fill='#7bf06b'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='28' width='10' height='8' rx='4' fill='#4fc63a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='19' ry='16' fill='url(#g)'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='14' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#e8ffb0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- antler stalks -->
  <rect x='35' y='2' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#3bbf2e'/>
  <rect x='61' y='2' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#3bbf2e'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='2' r='4' fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='2' r='4' fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='19' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#0d2b1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='19' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#0d2b1a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='16' r='2' fill='#e8ffb0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='16' r='2' fill='#e8ffb0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 26 Q50 32 56 26' stroke='#0d2b1a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='20' r='4' fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <rect x='17' y='6' width='3' height='14' fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='16' r='4' fill='#ff9de0'/>
  <rect x='89' y='3' width='3' height='13' fill='#ff9de0'/>
</svg>
